valueBasis: Per database reference portion: 100 g, 100 ml, or one item where applicable. BLS values are per 100 g. CoFID values are per 100 g except alcoholic beverages, which are per 100 ml. Values are converted only when a documented density or specific gravity is available.
nullPolicy: A source blank, dash, N, trace, or below-detection marker is not a numeric zero. It remains null until a reliable numeric value is found.

coverageNotes.BLS_4_0: BLS 4.0 supplies total Omega-3, total Omega-6, and alcohol, but not total trans fat. Closest-match values are recorded with total-fat comparisons; markers such as <LOD are not converted to zero.
coverageNotes.CoFID_2021: CoFID 2021 values are per 100 g except alcoholic beverages, which are per 100 ml. Tr and N remain nonnumeric markers.
coverageNotes.USDA_and_logical_zero_updates_2026_09_24: Added per-100-ml Omega values for maple syrup and apple juice using USDA SR Legacy household-portion gram weights and the US cup volume. The total-fat cross-check for both generic USDA matches differs from the database row and is recorded on the source records. Apple-juice trans fat remains null because exact CoFID reports Tr. Added family sums for Greek yogurt from specifically classified n-3/n-6 components while recording the 0.017 g/100 g unassigned PUFA residual. Added explicit composition-based zeros for dry/unfermented foods and selected non-oil plant foods; marker Tr and <LOD values were not converted to numeric zero.
coverageNotes.Researched_updates_2026_09_24: Added exact or documented close-match values for drained artichoke hearts, hard cheese, pork bratwurst, wheat roll, ghee, dates, gelatin, plus composition-based zeros where the food identity excludes trans fat or ethanol. Trace and below-detection markers remain nonnumeric. Generic vegetable-juice Omegas were withheld because of a substantial total-fat mismatch and unverified volume conversion. Added close-class BLS values for mature dry peas and exact-class BLS values for barley flakes; filled non-alcoholic zero values for plain chocolate, raw duck, and light cream cheese. Color-specific yellow pea values and other recipe-dependent values remain null. Added close-class BLS values for mature dry peas and exact-class BLS values for barley flakes; filled non-alcoholic zero values for plain chocolate, raw duck, and light cream cheese. Color-specific yellow pea values and other recipe-dependent values remain null. Added close-class BLS values for mature dry peas and exact-class BLS values for barley flakes; filled non-alcoholic zero values for plain chocolate, raw duck, and light cream cheese. Color-specific yellow pea values and other recipe-dependent values remain null.
coverageNotes.WhiteWineVinegarAlcoholConversion: Weinessig alcohol filled from the BLS analyzed value and converted to the database ml basis using the published white-wine-vinegar subgroup mean density. Buttermilk and sweetened dried cranberries remain null for alcohol because BLS reports <LOD, not a confirmed zero.
coverageNotes.Batch001_PastaAndCornichon: Added a medium-low-confidence generic wholegrain-pasta fatty-acid proxy for dry spelt pasta and exact drained-cornichon BLS values. The BLS cornichon ethanol analysis (0.018 g/100 g) takes precedence over a prior generic CoFID zero; this source conflict is explicitly retained in the audit.
coverageNotes.RemainingNulls_2026_09_24: This list is generated from the actual first-100 database records after researched updates. Trace markers and below-detection-limit readings remain null; neither means confirmed zero.

DerivedTotalFatZero.citation: Derived from Total Fat (g) in the database, checked against numeric source values in the batch audit.
DerivedTotalFatZero.rule: For an exact database value of 0 g total fat, missing Omega-3, Omega-6, and trans-fat values may be derived as 0 g only when no positive numeric source value for that field contradicts the derivation.

USDA_FoodData_Central_SR_Legacy_2018.citation: USDA Agricultural Research Service, FoodData Central, SR Legacy, April 2018. Direct records and nutrient amounts per 100 g edible portion.
USDA_FoodData_Central_SR_Legacy_2018.omegaMethod: Sum reported n-3/n-6 components without double-counting undifferentiated totals; accept Omega-3/Omega-6 sums only when they reconcile to total polyunsaturated fatty acids within 0.01 g or 1 percent. Foods using ml or other units receive only source zeros until an approved conversion is available.

FDA_TransFat_Overview.citation: FDA, Trans Fat. Describes partially hydrogenated oils as the major artificial source and natural trans fat in ruminant foods; used only as context for composition-based zeros on non-oil plant foods.

MEXT_Standard_Tables_2023.citation: Standard Tables of Food Composition in Japan, 2023 supplement; salted chum salmon roe (ikura), fatty acids per 100 g edible portion.

BLS_4_0_WhiteWineVinegar.citation: Max Rubner-Institut, Bundeslebensmittelschlüssel 4.0, Weinessig (R121000), alcohol 0.103 g/100 g, analytical value.

densityConversion.citation: Chang, Lee and Ou (2005), Investigation of the Physicochemical Properties of Concentrated Fruit Vinegar, Journal of Food and Drug Analysis 13(4), Table 6, white wine vinegar subgroup mean density 0.99 g/mL.

BLS_4_0_WholegrainPastaProxy.citation: Max Rubner-Institut, Bundeslebensmittelschlüssel 4.0, Vollkornteigwaren eifrei, roh (E510000), per 100 g edible portion.
BLS_4_0_WholegrainPastaProxy.limitation: Generic wheat wholegrain pasta comparator for spelt pasta; do not treat as an exact spelt analysis.

BLS_4_0_DrainedCornichons.citation: Max Rubner-Institut, Bundeslebensmittelschlüssel 4.0, Cornichons gesäuert, abgetropft (G890902), per 100 g edible portion.

Matvaretabellen_2026.citation: Official Norwegian Food Safety Authority food-composition table; item-level values and source details checked 2026-09-24.
